# anthropic_memory_store (Data Source)

Get information about a single Memory Store by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_memory_store" "example" {
  id = "memstore_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Memory Store (`memstore_…`).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Memory Store was archived, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Memory Store was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the Memory Store.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the Memory Store.
- `name` (String) Name of the Memory Store.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the Memory Store was last updated.
